dropzone: Drag a document here to import it into your narrative structure
beta_texto: You can import .txt, .md, .docx, .pdf and .odt documents directly into your narrative structure. The assistant will attempt to automatically detect acts, chapters and scenes.
eliminar_mensaje: The file "{{name}}" will be removed from the list, but the imported content will remain in the narrative structure (scenes, chapters, acts). Continue?
vista_previa_no_disponible: Preview not available for this file type.
stopwords_modal_texto: Filtered words (stopwords) are common terms that the Oracle ignores during analysis to focus on relevant elements of your story. Add or remove terms as needed.
